title: Tableau/HILL source-map evaluation boundary plan
rationale: This lane records the Rumkin HILL/tableau open question and fixes a source-backed 7-by-14 padded K4 coordinate mapping before any future HILL/tableau scoring. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because it does not use known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, or public-fragment structure scores as discovery evidence.
prediction_target: Fix the row-major 7-by-14 mapping of K4 positions 1 through 97 plus padding cell 98, the public-anchor exclusion metadata, and the independent-observation boundary used before any source-backed non-anchor observations are scored.
discovery_inputs: Context-only Rumkin K4 reference noting the HILL/tableau open question
CIA sculpture context that K4 has 97 characters
Context-only Sanborn-papers rationale for one-padding 7-by-14 compatibility
Pre-score deterministic coordinate mapping emitted by tableau-hill-prediction-plan
No additive fragment scores, candidate key material, routes, or plaintext claims
evaluation_inputs: Validated source-backed non-anchor observations accepted by validate-tableau-hill-observations
Scoreable evaluation output only from evaluate-tableau-hill-prediction with source-backed positions-file input
Future source-backed non-anchor observations selected before any HILL/tableau score output
Future observations must be non-anchor K4 positions, not padding cells or public-anchor positions
controls: family-specific seeded same-size non-anchor position-set null control required before interpreting scores
multiple-comparison correction required before interpreting any HILL/tableau score
next-evidence-gate must advertise only validator/evaluator commands that use source-backed positions-file input
the committed source-mapping artifact must remain deterministic before any validator/evaluator can score observations
promotion remains blocked unless future source-backed evidence is positive after the predeclared controls
